text:
Sunset came at 4:32 this evening, and the clouds are thickening behind it as the next system slides in. We've had a dry, mild Sunday, with highs right around 50. Showers arrive after 7 or so and hang around on and off overnight. They'll be light, under a tenth of an inch, and we settle into the low 40s by morning. A light jacket will do if you're out early.

Monday is the wetter half of the pair. The best chance for showers comes through the morning commute, roughly 6 to 10, then they get patchier and wind down by mid-afternoon. Total rain is only about a tenth of an inch, with a high near 50. The models disagree a bit on how soggy it gets. One keeps it fairly dry, another is wetter, but I'd bet on a damp morning and a drier afternoon. Take the umbrella out the door, and plan any walk for after 3. Monday night turns colder, down around 35.

Tuesday brings another light round of showers by afternoon, and Wednesday dries out. Late in the week looks colder, with a possible rain and snow mix, but the track is still unsettled.
